title: Local testing with iOS
tagline: Run the backend on your Mac and point the SiteLog app at it, on the simulator or a real iPhone, to test a feature end to end before it reaches staging.
intro: Run the backend on your Mac and point the SiteLog app at it, on the simulator or a real iPhone, to test a feature end to end before it reaches staging.
Works from S1 on; each sprint's scenarios are in §6.

sections.title: 3. Point the app at your Mac

blocks.html:
• The app reads its backend URL from the build configuration (iOS project.yml, iOS F00). For a local run, set the Debug value and allow plain HTTP to local hosts in Debug only.
TargetBase URLATS
Simulatorhttp://localhost:3000NSAllowsLocalNetworking = YES (Debug Info.plist)
iPhone on the same Wi-Fihttp://<mac-name>.local:3000 (System Settings → General → Sharing → Local hostname)same key; iOS asks for Local Network permission once: allow
iPhone anywherean HTTPS tunnel, e.g. cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:3000 → https://….trycloudflare.comnothing to change
Staginghttps://api-staging.<domain>nothing to change
  • In iOS project.yml the Debug value is a build setting (not an .xcconfig, where // starts a comment and cuts http://). Run xcodegen after changing it.
  • The WebSocket URL is the same host with ws:// (local) or wss:// (tunnel, staging).
  • The iPhone also needs NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription in the Debug Info.plist for .local hosts.

blocks.html:
• In the app: Sign in with test1@example.com (the Firebase test user). The backend log shows the first signed-in request with uid.
  • For curl next to the app, the same user:
bash
TOKEN=$(npm run -s token -- test1@example.com '<password>')
  • Two simulators as "two devices": Xcode → Window → Devices and Simulators → add a second iPhone simulator, run the app on both, sign in with the same user.

ResetCommand
Local database (everything)docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d && npm run migrate
One user's data and Firebase userthe app's Delete account, or curl -X DELETE localhost:3000/account -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
Dev bucketaws s3 rm s3://sitelog-dev-<account> --recursive
The appdelete it from the simulator (local store, Keychain stay until then)
  • After a database reset, devices still hold old cursors: delete and reinstall the app (or sign out and in), or the pull starts from a rev the new database never had.
